decisions.reason: GA4 remains the standard analytics setup for shops in 2025, so the plugin still fits the firm's core implementation, maintenance, and measurement services.
SEO support for shop relaunches remains a close, recurring complement to the firm's relaunch and performance-focused e-commerce business.
SEO workshops match the firm's marketing expertise and can support client acquisition and upselling, though training formats are somewhat less central than its core delivery services.
